text:
Mara: Ok confessional time. Who started the Moon Biscuit legend and why is there a tiny biscuit taped under the 4th floor kitchenette table? :thinking_face:

Juno: not me. but I did find crumbs leading to it last week. It's been worshipped by interns since 2023. :cookie:

Omar: I left that biscuit as an offering to the coffee machine after it mercilessly betrayed me with weak espresso. Rituals are real.

Priya: Whoever placed it owes the office a myth origin story. This is now a canonical Redwood artifact.

Lin: I vote we create a ritual: every time the build passes on first try, someone bows to the Moon Biscuit. :raised_hands:

Deskbot: Note: kitchen biscuit relocated to top shelf for preservation. Motion logged.

Eli: I will stake my reputation: it was me. I accidentally baked miniature biscotti and forgot them. They became symbolic.

Mara: Eli?? Legend confirmed. You must now tell the official origin tale with dramatic music at the next all-hands. :microphone:

Eli: Fine. Working title: 'The Night of One Hundred Commits and a Single Biscuit'. I will include interpretive dance.

Juno: interpretive dance is required. add tiny spotlight lamp to booking list.

Priya: Also proposing the Moon Biscuit be promoted to Prime Snack Emissary for a week. Responsibilities include: blessing the snack runs and judging cookie quality.

Lin: addendum: any snack offering must be accompanied by one haiku.

Omar: I can write haikus. Example: 'Steam sighs, code compiles / crumbs fall like tiny secrets / coffee guards the night.'

Mara: beautiful. Haiku rule approved. Deskbot, make a recurring reminder: 'Offerings and haikus due Fridays 4pm.'

Deskbot: Reminder scheduled: Offerings & Haikus — every Friday 16:00.

Eli: Also proposing an honorific nickname for Mara: "Keeper of Small Things" because she found Mochi's missing button last week.

Mara: I accept my tiny crown. Please stop putting batteries in the tiny biscuit though.

Juno: tiny batteries are a hard no. Also who took the sticker crown I left by the plants? :face_with_monocle:

Priya: guilty. used it to crown my laptop for good vibes. returning tonight with tiny apology cookies.

Mara: tiny apology cookies will be accepted by the Moon Biscuit Council. Photo evidence required. :camera_with_flash:

Omar: I will build a shrine (cardboard + washi tape). Volunteers to help decorate?

Lin: I'll bring glow stars. Eli will choreograph the interpretive dance. Juno will bring solemn kazoo.

Eli: solemn kazoo confirmed. This is peak Redwood culture and I am proud.

Mara: Meeting adjourned. Next steps: shrine build party, Friday 3pm; kazoo rehearsal optional but encouraged; haiku submissions open. Long live the Moon Biscuit. :crystal_ball:
